evidence_used.title: E. coli O157:H7 outbreak linked to beef kofta from a named producer, consumers sickened

honest_assessment: Do not newsjack this. An active foodborne-illness outbreak with people harmed is being used as a promotional hook to sell subscriptions, which trips the brand-safety kill switch. Exploiting a live health crisis for marketing is indefensible and will draw backlash. If the brand has genuine safety expertise to offer the public interest, that is a separate, non-promotional decision.

next_move.rationale: No PR handoff is appropriate; this is blocked on brand safety
